_doc: TANG 1 — CONG SOAT SAU NHAP (chep Sales Desk ai_fallback.js enforceReplyEvidence + ai_fallback_gate.js enforcePolicyClaims + payment_claim_kit.js, 25/09/2026). Phan CHUNG moi nganh: danh tinh bot, cau 'da nhan tien' (bot KHONG BAO GIO tu xac nhan — anh Dung chot 24/09), xin SDT khi chot (he thong gui phieu), coc / so tien khong nguon, hua doi tra khong chinh sach, 'da doi xong', xin them anh → link, link trang khac, ETA khong nguon, trang thai don khong tra cuu, tu cho tra sau, noi link quen. Regex chay tren CAU DA BO DAU (tru truong ghi 'cut'/'codeInLink'/'carrierCode'/'codePattern' chay tren cau goc). Cho trong: {khach}/{Khach} (xung ho), {shop}, {site}, {tenShop}, {tenNguoiPhuTrach}, va cho rieng tung luat ({ten} {ma} {size} {ton} {gia} {link} {danhSach} {cm} {doiDangDi}). KHONG ten rieng shop, KHONG con so rieng shop (validator chan). Nganh ghi de tung khoa trong nganh/<id>/cong-soat.json (danh sach noi them, chu ghi de).
